title: Built for large amounts. Certainty on every transfer. Introducing Remitly Reserve.
summary: Remitly Reserve brings greater rate and speed certainty to customers moving large amounts across borders.
body_markdown:
*Remitly Reserve brings greater rate and speed certainty to customers moving large amounts across borders.*


For some Remitly customers, moving large amounts across borders is a routine part of their financial lives. They are moving their savings between countries, buying homes, paying mortgages or tuition, and supporting family through a major life event or purchase.


Whatever the amount, customers want peace of mind their money is safe, what exchange rate they will get, and when it will arrive.


Remitly moves billions of dollars with low costs, fast delivery and a global network customers trust. That network reaches thousands of banks, in more than 175 countries and over 100 currencies, enabling needs ranging from everyday remittances to large-amount transfers.


**How Remitly Reserve works. No signup required!**


Exclusively tailored for customers who send more than $5,000 at a time, Remitly Reserve adds more certainty for customers already trusting Remitly.


More money arrives home, on every transfer you send. No more price shopping. No more wondering if now is the right time to send. Customers eligible for Remitly Reserve will automatically see top-tier rate on all transfers regardless of size, protection from short-term rate swings, dedicated support, and instant transfers when using a verified bank account. When moving a larger amount, even tiny shifts in exchange rates makes a meaningful difference. Remitly Reserve gives certainty about rates and how quickly money will arrive.


This is just a start. More benefits are coming for customers who regularly move large amounts to improve an experience they already know and trust.


*Reserve benefits are launching for eligible customers sending from the U.S., Canada and the U.K. Rates vary by payment method. Eligibility requirements and terms apply. Download our latest app on iOS or Android, or visit*[remitly.com](http://www.remitly.com/money-transfer/large-amounts) *to learn more.*
